Package com.im.njams.sdk

Class NjamsModel

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.NjamsModel
  • public class NjamsModel
extends Object
    Owns the process models, taxonomy tree, images and process diagram tooling of an Njams client, and assembles and sends project messages. Obtain via njams.model().

      • create

        public ProcessModel create​(Path absoluteProcessPath)
        Create a process and add it to this instance.
        Parameters:
        absoluteProcessPath - the absolute path of the process to create. It must start with this client's path (see NjamsMetadata.getClientPath()); a path relative to the client can be built with getClientPath().getOrCreateChild(...).
        Returns:
        the new ProcessModel
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if the path does not start with the client path

      • create

        public ProcessModel create​(String processName)
        Create a process directly below this client's path and add it to this instance. Convenience for the common single-element case; equivalent to create(getClientPath().getOrCreateChild(processName)).
        Parameters:
        processName - the name of the process as a single path segment directly below the client path; must not be null, blank, or contain >
        Returns:
        the new ProcessModel

      • add

        public void add​(ProcessModel processModel)
        Adds a process model to this instance. The model must be built for this instance and must be added before start(): process models are announced to the nJAMS server in the project message assembled at start, so a model added afterwards would silently never reach the server. To register a process once the client is already started, use create(Path) and announce it with the additionalResources() builder.
        Parameters:
        processModel - The model to be added. A NjamsSdkRuntimeException is thrown if the given model was created for another instance than this.
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if the client has already been started

      • addImage

        public void addImage​(String key,
                     String resourcePath)
        Adds an image for a given resource path. Images must be registered before start(): additional project messages sent for lazily added model do not transport images yet, so an image added after start would silently never reach the nJAMS server.
        Parameters:
        key - the key of the image
        resourcePath - the path where to find the image
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if the client has already been started

      • addImage

        public void addImage​(ImageSupplier imageSupplier)
        Add an image with an arbitrary supplier implementation. Images must be registered before start(): additional project messages sent for lazily added model do not transport images yet, so an image added after start would silently never reach the nJAMS server.
        Parameters:
        imageSupplier - the supplier used by SDK to find the image
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if the client has already been started

        Set the type for a TreeElment given by a path. Tree-element types are announced to the nJAMS server in the project message at start and must be set before start().

      • getGlobalVariablesPattern

        public String getGlobalVariablesPattern()
        Returns the regular expression that defines how global-variable references are detected and replaced in this client's configurations. When null, the nJAMS server applies its own default matching behavior.
        Returns:
        the global-variable matching pattern, or null if none was set

      • setGlobalVariablesPattern

        public NjamsModel setGlobalVariablesPattern​(String globalVariablesPattern)
        Sets the regular expression that defines how global-variable references are detected and replaced in this client's configurations, overriding the nJAMS server's default matching. The pattern must use named groups: full (the entire reference, e.g. %%var%%) and name (the variable name) are required; default (a fallback value) and optional (any non-blank match marks the reference as optional) are optional. The pattern is transported to the server with the project message.
        Parameters:
        globalVariablesPattern - the regex pattern, or null to clear it and let the server apply its default behavior
        Returns:
        this facet, for call chaining
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if the pattern is not a valid regular expression or does not declare the required named groups full and name, or if the client has already been started — a later change would never reach the server
